command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -mattr=+c -filetype=obj RV-P7-caddi.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each (LF, trailing newline): `c.addi a0, 1` / `addi a0, a1, 1` / `c.addi a0, -32` / `c.addi a0, 31` / `c.addi a0, -1`. The second line is the 4-byte standard form on the same immediate, to show the plan never gets a short form it did not name. `addi a0, a0, 1` is deliberately absent: with `-mattr=+c` llvm-mc auto-compresses it to `05 05`, which is exactly the implicit selection the plan-side `form_id` prevents (EXP-0012 §2).
